did.abstract: The Records of the Department of Communication, Steinhardt School of Culture, Education and Human Development contain publications and audiovisual recordings relating to Steinhardt's Education and Health programs.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Donated by Tanya Gary of the Steinhardt Department of Communication on October 21, 2026. The accession number associated with this gift is 2026.060.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection has not been arranged by an archivist. The materials are arranged in the order in which they were received from the donor.

bioghist.head: Historical Note
bioghist.p: The New York University Steinhardt School of Culture, Education and Human Development was originally founded as the School of Pedagogy in 1890. It was named the School of Education in 1921, the School of Education, Health, Nursing, and Arts Programs (SEHNAP) in 1974, the Steinhardt School of Education in 2001, and the Steinhardt School of Culture, Education and Human Development in 2007.

Steinhardt offers undergraduate, master's, advanced certificate, and doctoral degree programs in applied psychology, the visual and performing arts and arts professions, education, health, and media. It also previously offered Public Health programs, which were transferred to the School of Global Public Health by 2016, and Nursing programs, which moved to the newly formed College of Nursing in 2005.

phystech.head: Audiovisual Access Policies and Procedures
phystech.p: Audiovisual materials have not been preserved and may not be available to researchers. Materials not yet digitized will need to have access copies made before they can be used. To request an access copy, or if you are unsure if an item has been digitized, please contact NYU Special Collections (special.collections@nyu.edu, 212-998-2596) with the collection name, collection number, and a description of the item(s) requested. A staff member will respond to you with further information.

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Identification of item, date; Records of the Department of Communication, Steinhardt School of Culture, Education and Human Development; RG 26.44; box number; folder number or item identifier; New York University Archives, New York University.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: In October 2026, materials were placed in acid-free folders and manuscript boxes.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Records of the Department of Communication, Steinhardt School of Culture, Education and Human Development (1975-2021) contain publications relating to Steinhardt's Education and Health programs. Publications include administrative reports, such as an Institutional Report for the National Council for Accreditation of Teacher Education from 1975, the 1988 Long Range Plan, and a Report on Gifts, Grants and Contracts from 1998. They also include promotional materials such as booklets from the Undergraduate Admissions Program and the Graduate programs, a themed address book, and the 2021 book "The Origin Story: An Oral History of the Founding of NYU Abu Dhabi, 2005-2010."
This collection also includes video recordings of a Steinhardt School of Education Convocation program, and a School of Education event featuring author Frank McCourt.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Any rights (including copyright and related rights to publicity and privacy) are held by New York University. Permission to publish or reproduce materials in this collection must be secured from the University Archives. Please contact NYU Special Collections, special.collections@nyu.edu, 212-998-2596.
